nodes.label: gh-778 chroma envelope: curve as spec, presets, tolerance gates
src/engine/tonal.js (pure engine)

ENVELOPE_PRESETS exported from tonal.js: named slider quadruples {name, damp, dampCurve, dampAmp, dampBias}, incl. the curated corpus setting 70/1.5/0/0 and the kit default 80/1.5/0/0; envelopePresetOf(controls) returns the matching name or null

stop record gains env (the multiplier at the stop), model (continuous post-clamp chroma in the path's own unit: OKHSL s on perceptual/peak, CAM16 C on even), on even also basis (the intended fed to evenChroma) and floor (its floorC), and refined (set by enforceMonotonePixelL, anchored paths only); set at the 4 call sites, chromaEnvelope verbatim, no new chromaEnvelope( occurrence

scripts/lib/envelope-measure.mjs returns per-instance, per-stop residues (readback minus model, in the path unit and in local 8-bit code steps) alongside the existing READING (a) results; report-preset-fidelity --envelope keeps its printed numbers

nodes.label: the tolerance probe: `--envelope-residue` prints the residue distribution (max, p99, p50) per mode, per stop set, anchored and gate path, in both candidate units, and the worst witnesses
nodes.accept: `node scripts/report-preset-fidelity.mjs --envelope-residue` exits 0 and prints a max/p99/p50 row for each of perceptual/peak/even x 19-stop/25-stop x anchored/gate-path, plus the top 5 witnesses by residue; its output is saved to the artifacts dir as the evidence the TOL ruling reads

nodes.label: Gate A (curve exactness): for every corpus instance and stop, record.env equals the gate's own closed form (sliders -> mode map -> curve, re-derived from exported constants EVEN_DAMP_FACTOR/OKHSL_DAMP_D/OKHSL_DAMP_RESIDUE_EXP/OKHSL_DAMP_CURVE_GAIN/EVEN_NEIGHBOURHOOD_R, never by calling chromaEnvelope) to 1e-12; perceptual/peak: model/model500 === env wherever no clamp binds (not capped, model in (0,1)); even: model === min(maxc, max(basis*env, floor)) with the dampAmp-0 min(., model500) cap on the unanchored path
nodes.accept: `npm run gate:chroma-envelope` exits 0; `node test/engine/chroma-envelope-gate.mjs --spec dampCurveGain=1` (gate computes a wrong model) exits 1 naming >0 stops in perceptual and peak; `--spec evenFactor=1` exits 1 naming >0 even stops

nodes.label: Gate B (quantization residue): |readback(emitted) - record.model| <= TOL at every stop, TOL named once as code steps (TOL_CODES for plain stops, enforceMonotonePixelL's RADIUS for refined stops; capped stops one-sided); the constant comes from the probe plus owner ruling
nodes.accept: `npm run gate:chroma-envelope` exits 0 at the ruled TOL; `node test/engine/chroma-envelope-gate.mjs --engine-dir <scratch tree>` with OKHSL_DAMP_CURVE_GAIN set to 1 in that tree's tonal.js exits 1; a scratch tree with anchorChromaBasis returning anchorValue exits 1 on even Gate A; a scratch tree with sd keyed on the nominal stop exits 1 (the loader is the --base-dir precedent of report-preset-fidelity.mjs:67, passed through measureEnvelope({ engineDir }))
